title: 第七章 恐惧之力的现实应用第八章 吞噬进入
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
陆羽上前两步，伸手触摸面前幻化的墙壁。
刹那之间，墙面便是荡起了一圈涟漪，他的手臂径直穿了过去，没有感受到任何的阻碍。
“可惜了，这只是一种纯粹的视觉幻象而已...”
陆羽摇摇头，散去了门口的墙壁幻象。
当然，虽然感觉有些可惜，但是说实话，陆羽还真的没有多么失望，甚至说是欣喜居多。
毕竟，这可是真的超凡啊。
在一些时候骤然使出，也是能够起到不小的作用的。
比如...
陆羽再次凝神静气，那一堵墙壁以更快的速度幻化而出，而在一旁的墙壁所在，却是渐渐幻化出了一扇房门。
“嘿嘿...”
陆羽嘿声一笑，这要是在黑天的时候，能够在第一时间发现其中不妥的，恐怕不会太多吧？
在之后，陆羽又不断熟悉锻炼了一下，自己的幻化幻象能力。
到最后的时候，墙壁杯子之类的简单幻象，陆羽已经能够念动间幻化而出。
只不过，这种幻象不但只能进行视觉的欺骗，就连距离也是有着限制，只能在他周围的三米范围之内，幻化这种幻象。
不过，陆羽倒也是十分满足了，这毕竟也是一种超凡能力了啊。
紧接着，陆羽便是再此念头转动。
刹那之间，一股恐怖的气息扩散，瞬间笼罩了方圆三米之内。
然后，陆羽便就看到了一些墙角之处，突然爬出了一些蟑螂蚁虫，疯狂的向着周围逃窜。
并且，一股股近乎察觉不到的恐惧力量，不断涌入其体内的梦境世界。
陆羽迈动脚步，在整个房间走了一圈，一些蟑螂虫蚁，便是被其全部赶了出去。

而收获嘛，能够在无尽虚空，占据一片拳头大小的地盘。
这不能说是没有收获，但是对比无尽虚空，那只能说是沧海一粟。
不过，陆羽却是丝毫也不嫌弃，相比于幻象，这种散播恐惧，回收恐惧力量的能力，才算是他如今实力提升的根本。
那些蟑螂虫蚁，所能获取的恐惧力量，自然是极其微小。
但是，放在人类，亦或者是那些梦魔的身上，那可就是两种完全不同的概念了。
想想当初，他在那恐惧梦魔的身上，收获的数股强大恐惧力量，陆羽就是忍不住的一阵悸动，恨不得现在就出现两只梦魔。
“唔~...”
想到那种场景，陆羽不由就是微微兴奋的沉吟起来。
不知道以他如今的力量，能不能进入无尽虚空之外，那一片似乎是由梦境组成的光雾之中？
也许在那里，他还能够再次碰到梦魔呢？
想到这种可能，陆羽的心中又是激动起来，快速的返回床上躺下，准备进入梦境世界。
然而刚刚躺下，陆羽那已经变得敏感了一些的听力，便是听到了隔壁的吵闹声。
那似乎是一男一女。
此时，那一个女人，正以一个尖锐的声音，大骂者男方。
“废物、窝囊，我怎么会嫁给你？...”
“你特么既然不愿意跟我在一起，那就特么离婚...”
“你！
你说什么？你竟然敢跟我说离婚？你也不想想，就你这样的废物，和我离婚，谁还会嫁给你...”
“你...”
一道道刺耳嘈杂的声音传入耳中，使得陆羽眉头大皱。

不自觉的，一股恐怖的气息，自其身体瞬间散发而出，顷刻笼罩了方圆三米。
而陆羽和隔壁之间，虽然隔着一堵墙壁，但终归没有超过三米的范围。
content_en:
Lu Yu took two steps forward and reached out to touch the transformed wall in front of him.
In an instant, a circle of ripples appeared on the wall, and his arm went straight through without feeling any hindrance.
"What a pity, this is just a pure optical illusion..."
Lu Yu shook his head and dispersed the illusion of the wall at the door.
Of course, although it felt a bit pity, to be honest, Lu Yu was really not that disappointed, and was even more happy.
After all, this is truly extraordinary.
Using it suddenly at certain times can also play a big role.
For example...
Lu Yu calmed down again, and the wall transformed at a faster speed, while a door gradually transformed into the wall beside it.
"Hey hey..."
Lu Yu chuckled. If he could find something wrong in it at the first time during the black sky, I'm afraid there wouldn't be too many, right?
After that, Lu Yu continued to familiarize himself with and exercise his ability to transform into illusions.
By the end, Lu Yu was able to conjure up simple illusions such as cups on the wall with his thoughts.
However, not only can this illusion only be used for visual deception, but the distance is also limited. This illusion can only be transformed within a three-meter range around him.
However, Lu Yu was very satisfied. After all, this was an extraordinary ability.
Immediately afterwards, Lu Yu had this thought again.
In an instant, a terrifying aura spread, instantly covering a three-meter radius.
Then, Lu Yu saw some cockroaches and ants crawling out of some corners of the wall, and fled around crazily.
Moreover, a nearly imperceptible force of fear continued to pour into the dream world within his body.
Lu Yu took a step and walked around the entire room, driving out all the cockroaches and ants.
And the reward is to be able to occupy a territory the size of a fist in the endless void.
This cannot be said to be without gain, but compared to the endless void, it can only be said to be a drop in the ocean.
However, Lu Yu does not dislike it at all. Compared with illusions, this ability to spread fear and recover the power of fear is the basis for his current improvement in strength.
The fear power that those cockroaches, insects and ants can acquire is naturally extremely small.
However, when it comes to humans or those dream monsters, they are two completely different concepts.
Thinking about the powerful fear power he had harvested from that fearful dream demon, Lu Yu couldn't help but tremble, wishing that two dream demons would appear now.
"Hmm~..."
Thinking of that scene, Lu Yu couldn't help but groan with excitement.
I wonder if with his current strength, he can enter the mist outside the endless void that seems to be composed of dreams?
Maybe there, he could meet the Dream Demon again?
Thinking of this possibility, Lu Yu became excited again and quickly returned to the bed to lie down, preparing to enter the dream world.
However, just after lying down, Lu Yu's hearing, which had become more sensitive, heard the noise next door.
It seemed to be a man and a woman.
At this time, the woman was cursing the man with a sharp voice.
"Trash, useless person, how could I marry you?..."
"Since you don't want to be with me, then get divorced..."
"You!
What did you say? How dare you tell me about divorce? Don’t even think about it. If a loser like you divorces me, who will marry you..."
"You..."
A series of harsh and noisy sounds reached his ears, making Lu Yu frown.
Unconsciously, a terrifying aura instantly emitted from his body, covering a three-meter radius.
Although there was a wall between Lu Yu and the next door, it did not exceed three meters.
